name: Canva Omega Max — Federation Visual Intelligence Plane
source_of_truth_rule: Canva may visualise verified source-bound information but never becomes the canonical evidence, mission-state, authority or proof store.

universal_support.contract: Any current or future Federation system or service is eligible when it emits a typed VisualProjectionPacket containing system identity, source provenance, claims, proof state, authority, privacy and freshness.

invariants: visual output may not strengthen the supplied proof state
provider-current claims require fresh provider evidence when material
privacy and authority never inherit from adjacent systems
Canva output never becomes source truth merely because it is polished or approved

canva_capability_routes.new_doc_or_report: generate-design or supported Canva document workflow
canva_capability_routes.reuse: copy-design or visual-reference workflow before rebuild
canva_capability_routes.template_reuse: brand-template search/dataset/autofill only when template workflow is actually selected

visual_grammar.evidence: proof graph / source chain / claim state
visual_grammar.maturity: D0 -> I1 -> R2 -> B3 -> V4 ladder
visual_grammar.failure_learning: detect -> preserve -> classify -> recall -> model causes -> falsify -> search -> simulate -> rank -> authorise -> execute -> readback -> regress -> soak -> value -> learn -> diffuse -> prevent

reject_if: restricted information is projected into an unauthorised surface
a new design is materially worse than the proven incumbent pattern

loop: store only on authorised user-controlled surfaces

n_directive_binding.meaning: Within an active visual mission, exact n continues the highest-value safe visual packet toward the mission terminal condition.
must_not: send or publish without the relevant owner gate
claim hidden Canva generation or background work
replace source truth with visual state

terminal_condition: The requested visual mission is complete only when the required design family exists at the proven scope, has been read back, passes source/proof/privacy/authority QA, and its remaining maturity or provider gaps are explicitly stated.
